_meta.paper: arXiv:2607.13425 — Data-Efficient Adaptation of LLMs via Attention Head Reweighting (AHR)
_meta.source_of_predictions: analysis/core.md section 7 (pre-registered there); transcribed verbatim, not revised
_meta.tier: Tier 2 — minimal reimplementation (official repo contains no code)
_meta.scale_caveat: GPT-2-small (124M) and Qwen2.5-0.5B on laptop CPU, |D_train|=10, 3 seeds, 200 eval examples, fixed hyperparameters with NO cross-validation. The paper uses 4 models up to 8B, 10 seeds, full test sets, and 168-config CV per seed. Absolute numbers are NOT expected to match; only direction-of-effect is testable.

predictions.claim: gamma = 0 reproduces base-model logits exactly (AHR at init IS the frozen model, per Eq. 3).
predictions.expected: max abs deviation < 1e-4 between AHR-hooked forward pass with gamma=0 and clean base-model forward pass
predictions.not_supported_if: max_abs_dev >= 1e-4 — implementation is wrong and every downstream number is void

predictions.paper_basis: +6.23 points averaged over the 3 modern models at |D|=10 (recomputed from Appendix B)
predictions.partially_supported_if: AHR > LoRA on both but margin < 3.0 on at least one

predictions.claim: LoRA at 10 examples is worse than not training at all (Fig. 2b).
predictions.paper_basis: LoRA loses to ICL in 20 of 24 model x dataset cells at |D|=10
predictions.expected_direction: LoRA < ICL on at least one model

predictions.claim: AHR's advantage over ICL is a DECREASING function of base-model ICL competence. Weak model gains a lot; stronger model gains little.
predictions.paper_basis: On SST-2: GPT2-XL AHR-ICL = +14.71 vs Qwen3-8B = +0.91 (13.8-point gradient). Across all 6 datasets the per-model AHR-ICL sequence is monotone: +9.20, +3.42, -0.38, -1.45.
predictions.expected_direction: (AHR - ICL) on GPT-2-small > (AHR - ICL) on Qwen2.5-0.5B
predictions.expected_magnitude: >= 3.0 points of separation (smaller than the paper's 13.8, since Qwen2.5-0.5B is far weaker at ICL than Qwen3-8B)
predictions.not_supported_if: the two deltas are within 3.0 points, or the ordering reverses — which would mean AHR's value is NOT a function of base-model ICL competence and our reframing of the paper is wrong

predictions.claim: On a modern base model, AHR buys little or nothing over doing nothing.
predictions.paper_basis: The gradient predicts <= +3.42 (Llama-3.2-1B's value) for any model at or above that ICL competence; already negative at 3B (-0.38) and 8B (-1.45).
predictions.expected_direction: AHR - ICL on Qwen2.5-0.5B is small

variance_rule.statement: No direction may be declared from a delta smaller than seed variance. If |delta| < std across seeds, the verdict is 'indistinguishable at this scale', not a direction.
variance_rule.reporting: mean +/- std (population std across seeds) for every arm

notes_on_falsifiability: P1 and P2 restate the paper; passing them only validates the harness. P3 and P4 are the ones that can embarrass us. P3 is the experiment.
